steps.title: Why Reactive Integration?
steps.text: Reactive programming provides composable, fluent pipelines with unified error handling, backpressure support, and clean subscription lifecycle management.

steps.title: The Observer Pattern
steps.text: IObservable represents a push-based data source while IObserver receives notifications via OnNext, OnError, and OnCompleted callbacks.

steps.title: Surgewave as Observable
steps.text: Convert Surgewave consumers into IObservable sequences, then chain reactive operators like Filter, Map, and Buffer for declarative stream processing.

steps.title: Custom Operators
steps.text: Implement your own reactive operators using built-in .NET types. This unit uses only IObservable, IObserver, and IDisposable -- no external packages required.

steps.title: Decision Framework
steps.text: Consider push vs pull consumption, backpressure strategy, needed operators, error handling, and subscription lifecycle when designing reactive Surgewave pipelines.
